description: Land Title Settlement Department - Ganegoda, Elpitiya D/S Division, Galle District - Cad. Map No. 310734 (23/0056)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of land title determinations for specific parcels of land, including details of land owners, property boundaries, cadastral references, and land ownership particulars. The content focuses entirely on land registration and property rights, falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it involves land titles, ownership determinations, and property registrations without any government personnel changes or structural administrative matters.
